# Visualization taxonomy and Core Analytics Profile

Version 1 classifies 34 identities: 13 registered chart types and 21 pattern specifications in 8 families.

The Core Analytics Profile has 20 named cells: 13 surface-complete and 7 typed gaps.

Each identity has one primary family and at most one primary core cell. Core identities cover the basic profile; extensions add authoring, composition, interaction, or geographic capabilities. An extension may retain the core cell it elaborates.

A cell is surface-complete only when an identity assigned to that exact family and cell has public SVG proof. The identity lists below include unproved pattern candidates; a pattern does not inherit proof from its base chart type. Surface-complete describes public pixels, not certification, every theme, dashboard placement, or interaction support.

## Families

| Family | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| statistical | Compare values, show their distribution and composition, or examine relationships between measures. |
| temporal | Show ordered change over time, multiple series, reference targets, and cumulative progress. |
| financial | Express market ranges and changes in financial balances through specialized encodings. |
| hierarchy | Show nested containment and ancestor-descendant structure. |
| network | Show entities and their pairwise relationships or weighted adjacency. |
| flow | Show directed transfers and their magnitudes between stages or entities. |
| geo | Encode quantities and relationships using geographic positions or regions. |
| scientific | Show distribution summaries, frequencies, or continuous fields using specialized scientific encodings. |

## Core Analytics Profile

| Family / cell | Definition | State | Assigned identities | Gap reason |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| statistical / distribution | Show the spread or concentration of observations or frequencies. | surface-complete | `pattern:viz:bubble-distribution`, `pattern:viz:time-grid-heatmap` | — |
| statistical / comparison | Compare quantitative values across categories. | surface-complete | `bar`, `pattern:viz:detail-overview-bar`, `pattern:viz:diverging-bar`, `pattern:viz:grouped-bar`, `pattern:viz:simple-bar` | — |
| statistical / part-to-whole | Show how components contribute to a total. | surface-complete | `pattern:viz:drilldown-stacked-bar`, `pattern:viz:stacked-100-bar`, `pattern:viz:stacked-bar` | — |
| statistical / correlation | Show relationships between quantitative measures. | surface-complete | `scatter`, `pattern:viz:correlation-matrix`, `pattern:viz:correlation-scatter`, `pattern:viz:linked-brush-scatter` | — |
| temporal / trend | Show the trajectory of a measure over an ordered time axis. | surface-complete | `line`, `pattern:viz:focus-context-line`, `pattern:viz:sparkline-grid` | — |
| temporal / multi-series | Compare multiple named trajectories on a common time axis. | typed-gap | `pattern:viz:facet-small-multiples-line`, `pattern:viz:multi-series-line` | The multi-series pattern is classified but has no public pixel proof; the line type has trend as its primary core cell. |
| temporal / target | Compare a temporal trajectory against a reference target or band. | typed-gap | `pattern:viz:facet-target-band`, `pattern:viz:layered-line-area`, `pattern:viz:target-band-line` | Target-band patterns are classified but have no public pixel proof. |
| temporal / cumulative | Show an accumulated measure over time; supplied values must already encode the accumulation. | surface-complete | `area`, `pattern:viz:running-total-area`, `pattern:viz:stacked-area-projection` | — |
| financial / candlestick | Show open, high, low, and close values per time interval. | typed-gap | None | No registered candlestick type or pattern provides OHLC pixels; new financial chart types are deferred beyond Sprint 195. |
| financial / waterfall | Show sequential positive and negative contributions to a financial balance. | typed-gap | None | No registered waterfall type or pattern provides sequential balance pixels; new financial chart types are deferred beyond Sprint 195. |
| hierarchy / containment | Show hierarchy through nested rectangular containment. | surface-complete | `treemap` | — |
| hierarchy / radial | Show hierarchy through concentric radial partitioning. | surface-complete | `sunburst` | — |
| network / relation | Show entities connected by explicit relationships. | surface-complete | `force_graph` | — |
| network / adjacency | Show weighted pairwise connections; this cell does not require a matrix layout. | surface-complete | `chord` | — |
| flow / directed-flow | Show the direction and magnitude of transfers between stages or entities. | surface-complete | `sankey` | — |
| geo / choropleth | Encode a quantitative value through the fill of a geographic region. | surface-complete | `choropleth` | — |
| geo / proportional-symbol | Encode a quantitative value through symbol size at a geographic position. | surface-complete | `bubble_map` | — |
| scientific / box | Show quartiles, median, and whiskers of a quantitative distribution. | typed-gap | None | No registered box type or pattern provides quartile and whisker pixels; new scientific chart types are deferred beyond Sprint 195. |
| scientific / histogram | Show frequencies in explicitly defined quantitative bins. | typed-gap | None | No registered histogram type or pattern provides binned frequency pixels; new scientific chart types are deferred beyond Sprint 195. |
| scientific / contour | Show level sets of a continuous quantitative field. | typed-gap | None | No registered contour type or pattern provides continuous-field isolines; new scientific chart types are deferred beyond Sprint 195. |

## Regeneration

Edit only `packages/viz-core/src/registry/viz-classification.v1.json` for family, role, primary-cell, definition, and typed-gap decisions. The type population and public SVG flags come from `packages/viz-core/src/registry/viz-recipes.v1.json`; pattern IDs and hashes come from the specification files, and their public proof comes from `packages/viz-core/src/registry/viz-patterns.v1.json`.

```sh
pnpm exec tsx scripts/product-reality/s195-viz-taxonomy.ts
pnpm exec tsx scripts/product-reality/s195-viz-taxonomy.ts --check
```

The generator rejects unknown, duplicated, missing, or cross-family assignments. `--check` checks both the canonical JSON artifact and this document byte for byte. `OODS_VIZ_TAXONOMY_ROOT` or `--root <path>` selects another repository root.
